amed, reusable configurations that define how MCPJam connects to and talks to your MCP servers. Returns the `id`s and `configId`s
the detail and write routes take. Clients that exist only as the private backing of a User Testing study are omitted unless `inclu
…\n- [Create a client (from a template or a full config)](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/clients/create-a-client-from-a-tem
plate-or-a-full-config.md): Creates a client in the project and responds `201` with the new client's detail. Seed the config one o
f two ways: pass `template` (a built-in template id, optional `theme`) to seed server-side from the live backend client-template c
atalog, falling back to the bundled SDK catalog snapshot if the live…\n- [Get a client](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/clie
nts/get-a-client.md): One client's full settings, including its resolved config, its `configId` (the concurrency token every write
takes), and `impact` — what a config edit would follow. The path segment accepts a client **name or ID**. A client that exists bu
t belongs to a different project reads as `404 NOT_FOUND`.\n- [Delete a client](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/clients/dele
te-a-client.md): Permanently deletes the client. Refused while a live environment, an active legacy goal or an eval suite still ho
lds it — the error names what to detach first. Guest callers are denied (a write).\n- [Update a client](https://docs.mcpjam.com/ap
i-reference/clients/update-a-client.md): Edit a client's display name and/or its config. Two ways to change the config: `config` r
eplaces it wholesale, and `set` changes named fields over the config read inside the write transaction — prefer `set`, because a w
hole-config round-trip composed from a stale read reverts whatever landed in betw…\n- [Replace a client's servers](https://docs.mc
pjam.com/api-reference/clients/replace-a-clients-servers.md): Replaces the client's required and optional saved-server attachments
without round-tripping the whole config. Composed server-side from the client's current config, so every other setting is preserv
ed — and `expectedConfigId` is required so two concurrent server replacements cannot silently lose one…\n- [Duplicate a client](ht
tps://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/clients/duplicate-a-client.md): Creates a new client carrying the selected client's current co
nfig, and responds `201` with the copy's detail. Purely additive — the source is untouched.\n- [List server skills](https://docs.m
cpjam.com/api-reference/primitives/list-server-skills.md): Returns the Agent Skills a connected server serves over the MCP skills
extension (SEP-2640), including skills it advertises that MCPJam declines to load. Not paginated: the catalog is drained server-si
de, because duplicate detection spans the whole listing.\n- [List a suite's settings history](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-referenc
e/eval-suites/list-a-suites-settings-history.md): One entry per committed edit to the suite's settings, newest first: who made it,
which STORED fields moved, the note they left, how many runs were launched against it, and the revision group that ties one reque
st's writes together. Rows carry no configuration snapshots. Send a `revisionNumber` back…\n- [Attach one environment to a suite (
atomic append)](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-suites/attach-one-environment-to-a-suite-atomic-append.md): APPEND one
project environment to the suite's attachments, if it is not already there.\n- [List GitHub Checks repositories](https://docs.mcpj
am.com/api-reference/evals/list-github-checks-repositories.md): The repositories in this organization whose pull requests run an e
val suite, plus the repositories the MCPJam GitHub App can reach (the choices a connect has).\n- [Run an eval suite on a repositor
y's pull requests](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/evals/run-an-eval-suite-on-a-repositorys-pull-requests.md): Connect a rep
ository so every pull request to it runs one eval suite and reports a GitHub check. **Affects everyone who opens a pull request on
that repository**, and with `outagePolicy: fail_closed` it can block their merges.\n- [Request insights for an eval run](https://
docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/evals/request-insights-for-an-eval-run.md): **No credits are consumed** — the model cost is on MCPJa
m. Runs a model over the finished run and draws on the same shared `insightsPerDay` request ledger as swarm and user-testing insig
hts.\n- [Grade an eval run with LLM as Judge](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/evals/grade-an-eval-run-with-llm-as-judge.md):
**Spends.** Runs the goal-completion judge over the finished run, scoring each case's final answer against its expected output.\n
- [Save a server into a project](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/servers/save-a-server-into-a-project.md): Creates a saved M
CP server and responds `201` with its detail. This is the provisioning entry point: every eval, host and environment route address
es servers that were created here. Names are unique per workspace, so a clash responds `409` rather than silently returning the ex
isting row. Secret-bear…\n- [List a server's revisions](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/servers/list-a-servers-revisions.md)
: A saved server's stored revisions, newest first. A revision is a capture of the server's tools and server info, recorded wheneve
r they change on a connect, an eval run or a chat session. Reads stored data and never connects to the server, so it works for std
io servers too. A server the caller cannot…\n- [Get one saved server](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/servers/get-one-saved-
server.md): The server's detail, projected toward the hosted shape. Secrets are never included — `hasClientSecret` reports presenc
e only. A server id from another project reads as `404`.\n- [Update a saved server](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/servers/
update-a-saved-server.md): Sparse update: omitted fields are unchanged. Renaming re-checks per-workspace uniqueness (`409` on a cl
ash). Editing a server shared as an OAuth connection requires project admin. `clientSecret` and `clearClientSecret` are mutually e
xclusive.\n- [Check what this deployment's environment surface supports](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/environments/check-
what-this-deployments-environment-surface-supports.md): Report which environment features this MCPJam deployment accepts. Call it
